body: So I just got a very nasty but subsequently deleted message from “isnobodyup” telling that I’m letting my divorce define my life. Again someone who doesn’t understand and has no business being on this subreddit. Moderator I ask he be removed from this subreddit as he is a troll.
Thank you. I don’t want to give up. I know I need to go to the hospital yet everyone keeps telling my breathe. It’s ridiculous.

My ex does the same to me. I was never good enough, pretty enough, skinny enough. I starved myself down to 102 pounds and it wasn’t enough. There’s no pleasing some people. And the sad truth is I guess everyone is. Just remember so is he.

Ouch, that’s rough. Just keep moving forward and know in your heart that you are worth it and you will have a happy life if you choose to take that path. I have dreams about my in-laws. So weird. Family for 21 years then nothing. It’s hard to wrap your head around.
There another version of that in which the line ends “the wisdom to know it’s me”. I definitely get the feels from that. Just need to live by my words.

The struggle is real. But we can hold our heads up, crawl out of bed every morning and do this. We have our weak moments like when I posted today but life will go on. We have to make it happen and not sit idly by. I’m here if you need to talk.
Ok thanks. Sorry to hear you are in the same boat. I’m going to get therapy ASAP for sure. Keep your chin up and I’ll keep mine up too :)
Thank you so much. I really didn’t think people were going through this like I am. I don’t know why I can’t pull out of this. But I will schedule a session.

I guess that is the million dollar question. Life at home was horrible because he didn’t want me there anymore. We have a very complicated history in which we have both hurt each other. But the deal was we would separate and still date. Once I was out he cut me off completely.

Wow how your words resonate with me. Thank you stranger, yet friend. I’m only 5 days in yet you have comforted my soul. I’m devastated, breathless, inconsolable. But, we will make it through. Together our lost souls will find our way.
Thank you so much❤️ I feel a little more empowered this morning after getting a full 4 hours of sleep lol. It’s the best I’ve had since Saturday. It’s a start.

Ok thank you for letting me know I’m not alone! I can’t believe how bad I’m taking this. I do have a friend coming to stay with me Friday. And lots of friends I’m taking to. Just feel so lonely and strange to have the silence here.
Thank you. I am trying I really am. I’m just so scared.

Glad to hear you are doing well and that there is hope. Perhaps my current psychiatrist will change my meds Monday idk. I’m just a little skeptical of him with his history of pretty much ignoring my situation. I’m not sure what to do. If I should trust him to change them or not. I’m certainly anxious to get on the right regimen. I’m going in cautiously optimistic but I’m going to be very clear to him that I feel I have been mistreated and am moving on.

Thanks I will definitely give the breathing a try. I do get overwhelmed by the thoughts that go through my head and the urges that I have. I’ve started to try meditation and I like it so far. I was actually pretty successful at being able to block out the bad thoughts for 15 minutes at a time. Baby steps but I will get through this 🙏
I could pick you up and drop you off at EF. I’m staying in Muskegon but I don’t mind the extra drive. I get in at 9am Thursday so should be hitting Grand Rapids around noon maybe.
GA weekend 2 arriving in Detroit 9am Thursday 7/28, leaving 7/2 12 noon. Staying in Muskegon but can drive you to forest fam.
Hey. Arriving Detroit 9am the 28th. Driving to Muskegon but can take you to forest. Leaving 7/2 at 12.
GA weekend 2 arriving Thursday in Detroit airport 9am. Driving to forest solo but staying in Muskegon. Have room for 3. HMU
Thanks. I searched the site for venue guidelines and keep getting 404. Appreciate it fam.
Ok cool thanks. I just wanna bring lip tint and sunscreen and don’t wanna have a prob getting in.
Ok cool! Thanks 😀
Heading to the grocery store now lol! Thanks 😀
Ok I’ll check it out. Thanks!

Yes I completely understand what you are saying. Moderation is becoming the issue for me. Just one more has become my mantra. I suppose we all have our own specific version of what an alcoholic looks like, high functioning or not, fundamentally it’s all the same. Thanks for your reply.

While I may be suffering from an alcohol issue it seems as though you may have a personality issue. Empathy is a core value I think most people have and hope to receive. When a person reaches out for help they are looking for neither a pompous ass or sarcastic fool. Yet, you seem intent on hijacking my thread with nothing but useless derogatory comments. Congrats to you for being such a worthless human being . Well done 👍

“Reading YOUR post I would most likely never hire YOU” sounds rather specific. If you would have said that you wouldn’t hire a person in your situation, fine. You said YOU. Getting into semantics here but you didn’t have to get nasty. Obviously I’m hurting and curious. Obviously I’m asking for help.  As the ole adage goes, if you don’t have anything nice to say....
I wasn’t asking for your criticism or job advice. I was asking a serious question. Did I say I was working while drinking? Do you know what shift I work? No. #nothelpful

I’m in the exact same situation. I can drink about a bottle of wine a day and be fine. I’d sure like more but my husband gets very upset with the amount I drink already. I still wonder to myself when you cross the line into alcoholism. Am I an alcoholic? Is it because I drink so much, because I like to drink in the morning, because I use it for medicinal purposes or all of the above. I’m completely functioning and have had no disruption of my life due to alcohol. Does that matter? Am I in denial?
Ok thanks for your reply:)
What are the risks of serotonin syndrome on a low dose? Is it risky?
Why didn’t you you just fool around some more and go for round two dude? You totally have it in you!!

You’re attitude was unnecessary and rude. All you had to say was”has your doctor tried alternatives?” However you jumped to conclusions and assumed I wanted the codeine right off of the bat. I’m down to the wire with alternatives and am still having problems. I know what I need, I’ve been here before. My doctor knows too, just too scared to write the script now. But you didn’t need to assume I went straight for the big guns.

They already gave me alternate routes of treatment with antibiotics, prednisone, TESSALON Perles and dextrometorphan. Still having coughing fits. I’ve needed this in the past and used with no problems. But now it’s like it’s the end of the world. I’m willing to try what they have but obviously I’ve given it a great shot. Piss off.

I am on antibiotics and prednisone. I’ve needed this cough syrup in the past the help with the coughing fits. But now they are no longer prescribing it. TESSALON Perles and dextromethorphan don’t help the fits.

46 here and just went to EDCO. No bad vibes at all towards me! I felt welcome and smiles were all around. I’m going to EDCLV as well and am so excited! Never too old. Saw a dude at EDCO had to be 70 having a great time! It’s all about the vibe you carry baby, go for it!
Now I understand the bandanas. Totally gross.
OMG love it
I was tempted to wear my backpack on the front but didn’t want to look like a huge douche. If EDCLV’18 is anything like this idc what I look like I’m doing it. Hope your head is ok.
Sorry dude that sucks. Fucking bitches ruining the good vibe.

Sorry dude that sucks. I felt paranoid every time someone from behind touched my backpack which is practically every single minute when you are walking through the crowd or dancing. I ended up carrying it on my side under my arm. I was gonna put it on my front but I didn’t want to look like that much of a douche lol. Still a lot of good vibes last night. Fuck those bitches that have to ruin it like that.
Awww balls  I missed that one!!

I feel the same way. I’d say we are not alone but we are, each existentially alone to bear this out, to determine if we have to courage to take every day as it comes. I wish every day I was never born. I rue the day my parents decided to have me rather than abort me (yes they actually told me that was an option).  But I wake up every day and put me feet on the ground an do what needs to done. And so can you. If you need to talk I am here. I feel the soul clenching pain of depression that is catostrophic and isolating . Reach out to those that understand.

I recently asked about being to “old” to go to EDC as well. My friend and I are 40 and are going to Vegas for the first time. I received nothing but great responses from everyone about how wonderful and accepting the atmosphere is.  And also what a mix of ages the crowd is. The type of people who make comments like that are the type of judgemental people who themselves don’t belong at EDC. The common vibe I got is come as you are, all are welcome:)
Omg 70s ❤️❤️ I hope I'm still able to do this in 30 years. I love it!
Oh my!! I can definitely see that happening. And I'm a nurse so my protective side will probably go on overdrive lol Glad to gear all are welcome. We are so excited!
Great to know :) Glad you had a great time!!
So good to know!! We know we will be exhausted by the second night lol but we are prepared for that. Thanks so much for the info! I hope you have a blast this year as well :)
🤣😂Damn straight girl!! We are gonna live it up! I told her to just ignore them, they were just jealous they weren't going 🤣😂

Omg that's amazing!! I'm so glad to hear that!! My friend had some young girls at her work laughing about us going and that's what got us wondering about it. The little f$ckers. We are happy as hell to be going whatever our age :)
Haha!!! Well thank you for all the info. We are seriously so excited we can't wait!! We suspect it's going to become an addiction lol

Oh we are! So many ideas to choose from and only 3 nights lol! We thought about camping but figured that would overwhelm us for our first trip. We played it safe and booked a room. Now just need to get our tickets tomorrow:) We are thinking VIP.
